item.description: The Tags class validation logic incorrectly rejects valid Tag objects in the Items array when they are passed as dictionaries with "Key" and "Value" fields. This is causing test_tags_items_array to fail because it expects the validation to accept such dictionary representations.
item.contract: The Tags class should accept Tag objects or dictionaries containing "Key" and "Value" fields in the Items array. When processing Items arrays, it should validate that each item is either a Tag object or a dictionary with "Key" and "Value" fields, and convert them appropriately for internal storage.

item.description: The Parameter class validation incorrectly restricts AllowedPattern to only String types, preventing CommaDelimitedList types from using this property as required by AWS CloudFormation specification.
item.contract: The Parameter class validation should allow AllowedPattern to be used with both String and CommaDelimitedList types, consistent with AWS CloudFormation requirements. The validation should be updated to permit this usage.

item.description: The DBInstance validation logic has inconsistent error messages compared to what the test expects. The error message doesn't match the expected format, causing test_it_rds_instances_require_either_a_snapshot_or_credentials to fail.
item.contract: The DBInstance validation should produce the exact error message expected by the test: "Either (MasterUsername and either MasterUserPassword or ManageMasterUserPassword) or DBSnapshotIdentifier are required".

item.description: The Tags class validation logic needs to properly handle the case where Tags are passed as dictionaries with an "Items" key. Currently, it incorrectly raises TypeError when the Items list contains valid Tag objects or dictionaries.
item.contract: The Tags class constructor should properly process the Items array when it contains valid Tag objects or dictionaries with "Key" and "Value" fields, allowing the Tags to be created successfully.
